strongest_rejection_reason: Reviewers may argue that national OEWS cells cannot separate establishment pay-setting from worker sorting or regional cost of living, so the 'same job' gap could partly reflect who works where.
response_to_rejection_reason: The manuscript states the estimand as a descriptive same-occupation pay difference. It relies on hydroelectric parity and the occupational gradient as patterns that location alone would not easily produce, and it names worker-level and state-level data as the needed next test.

unsupported_leap_scan.summary: Mechanism language in the Discussion was softened to most consistent with, and the text states that rents, unions and preferences are not measured.

missing_rival_scan.summary: Compensating differentials, regional cost of living, worker sorting and a nuclear premium are each discussed, the last with a fossil-only comparison.

claim_strength_scan.summary: No causal verbs about renewable employment; estimates described as same-occupation differences in average pay.

workflow_language_scan.summary: Internal workflow vocabulary appears only inside HTML trace comments, never in visible prose.
